claim_semantics.true: asserted executable in the stated scope
claim_semantics.false: asserted not executable in the stated scope
claim_semantics.unknown: insufficient evidence; run the bounded probe before promotion

cases.operation: Read the local Docker daemon server version without starting a container.
cases.scoped_claim_reason: Binary and client version do not establish daemon/socket availability under the current seatbelt.

cases.operation: Launch /usr/bin/true under a permissive sandbox-exec profile.
cases.scoped_claim_reason: Executable presence does not establish that nested sandbox profile application is permitted.

cases.operation: Use sandbox-exec to deny a child process access to one synthetic private canary while the parent can read it.
cases.scoped_claim_reason: The boundary requires both successful profile application and observed access denial, neither yet tested.

cases.operation: Create a top-level repository branch through an unapproved git switch -c path.
cases.scoped_claim_reason: Top-level .git is read-only in the default sandbox and the observed HEAD.lock attempt failed.

cases.operation: Create a top-level repository branch through the pre-approved git checkout -b route.
cases.scoped_claim_reason: The exact action prefix is pre-approved and the postcondition was verified.

static_profile_evidence: CodexPro connector and agent-oriented handoff tools visible
